automation.command_line_help:
Usage

Start an application through the transparent proxy:
ProxyLane.exe --auto --profile <profile name> --run <application path> [-- <application arguments...>]

Show this help:
ProxyLane.exe /?

Options
--auto       Use command-line automation mode.
--profile    Select a saved profile.
--run        Select the application to start through the proxy.
--           Preserve the remaining raw arguments; expand environment variables at launch.
/?, -?, --help    Show this help.

Example
ProxyLane.exe --auto --profile "Test" --run "C:\Tools\app.exe" -- -arg value

An existing instance with the same installation, user session, and profile is reused.

Shortcut options
--arguments    Legacy shortcut compatibility; use -- for new commands.
--working-directory    Application working directory.
--elevated    Launch the application as administrator.
--packaged    Interpret --run as a packaged app AUMID.
--shortcut    Run in the tray and notify launch results.
--app-name    Application display name for notifications.
